articles.title: Letter: the Millrace Library Branch Did a Good Job This Summer
body: To the editor: I have lived on Copper Place for 16 years, and I want to say what a difference the Millrace Library branch has made. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the October meeting. Please keep the community oven in the budget. Many of us on Copper Place use it every week.

body: Born in Kettle Hill in the years after the war, Dominic Yates spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Dominic Yates died in August at home on Elm Drive, at the age of 83.
